manualReview.summary: Dedicated hypothalamus paper and author DE list located; no female P37-versus-P22 author table
manualReview.note: BioStudies lists 48 hypothalamus libraries across P12/P22/P27/P32/P37 and both sexes, with a count matrix, IDF and SDRF. It cites PMID 36221127 (PMC9552479) for protocols and states these tissues came from the same mice as the pituitary experiment; that manuscript's result datasets are pituitary E-MTAB-9459/-9460, so it remains a methods reference only. 2026-11-15: the dedicated hypothalamus paper is Sokolowski et al. 2024, Biol Sex Differ 15:83 (PMID 39449090, PMC11515584), whose data availability names E-MTAB-12340, a Zenodo Shiny app and Figshare code/data. The author Shiny repository wilsonlabgroup/hypothalamus_gene_shiny at commit 9b05a52 holds hypo_utr_2021_de_result_list_2022-10-19.rds, a list of 17 author DE comparisons (sex at each age; within-sex d22/d27/d32/d37 plus d32_22 and d37_27 for each sex). None is a female PD37-versus-PD22 comparison. The logCPM, F and PValue columns are constant 1 placeholders, so only logFC and FDR are informative. The registered female P37-versus-P22 track therefore has no same-contrast author table; no reconstruction was performed and no numerical disagreement is claimed.
reviewFlags: Do not use the linked pituitary results as verification of the hypothalamus contrast.
Author consecutive-age contrasts (d32_22F, d37_27F) are not the registered PD37-vs-PD22 contrast; do not sum LFCs into a pseudo-contrast.

verificationReview.reason: 2026-11-15: the dedicated hypothalamus paper is Sokolowski et al. 2024, Biol Sex Differ 15:83 (PMID 39449090, PMC11515584); its data availability names E-MTAB-12340, a Zenodo Shiny app (10.5281/zenodo.10899706) and Figshare code/data (10.6084/m9.figshare.25517503). The paper's methods list author DE (DESeq2, FDR<0.05 and |FC|>=1.5) between sexes at each age and, within sex, between consecutive ages only (12-22, 22-27, 27-32, 32-37). The author Shiny repository wilsonlabgroup/hypothalamus_gene_shiny (commit 9b05a52) holds hypo_utr_2021_de_result_list_2022-10-19.rds with 17 comparisons, including female d22_F, d27_F, d32_F, d37_F, d32_22F and d37_27F; d32_22F and d37_27F are inferred from their labels to be 32-vs-22 and 37-vs-27 comparisons, which no retained source documents. None is a female PD37-versus-PD22 comparison. Its logCPM, F and PValue columns are constant 1 placeholders, so only logFC and FDR are informative and raw P cannot be assessed. The registered female P37-versus-P22 track therefore has no same-contrast author table; combining contrasts would be a derived reconstruction and was not done. Paper-content claims rest on full text and supplements whose hashes are recorded but which were not retained; the RDS and scripts.R independently corroborate the thresholds. Evidence is in continued-sources/E-MTAB-12340/turbo-2026-11-15-notloc3/.
verificationReview.nextStep: Inspect the Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.25517503 archive (2.0 GB) or the Zenodo app snapshot for a female PD37-versus-PD22 result or full DESeq2 outputs; otherwise record a scoped comparison against the nearest author contrasts, labelled as non-registered.
